description: This file defines the FrameMap class, which provides methods for mapping between entries and frames ranges in a trace, using lookup tables for efficient conversions.

classes.name: FrameMap
classes.description: A class that manages bidirectional mapping between entries and frames in trace data, supporting range queries.

methods.name: getFramesRange
methods.description: Returns the frames range corresponding to a given entries range.

methods.name: getFullTraceFramesRange
methods.description: Returns the full range of frames for the entire trace.

methods.name: getEntriesRange
methods.description: Returns the entries range corresponding to a given frames range.

methods.name: getStartFrameOfFirstGreaterOrEqualMappedEntry
methods.description: Retrieves the start frame for the first entry index greater than or equal to the given index.

methods.name: getEndFrameOfLastLowerOrEqualMappedEntry
methods.description: Retrieves the end frame for the last entry index less than or equal to the given index.

methods.name: getStartEntryOfFirstGreaterOrEqualMappedFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the start entry for the first frame index greater than or equal to the given index.

methods.name: getEndEntryOfLastLowerOrEqualMappedFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the end entry for the last frame index less than or equal to the given index.
